blockers.lead: The arrival only closes once the invoices to return are returned or undone:

list.title: Damage reports of the arrival
list.photoGone: The photo is no longer available.

caseActions.title: Case
caseActions.settlementRequired: The decision was “goods paid”: record the settlement before closing.

submit.title: Send this damage to the contractor?
submit.body: The contractor will see the damage in the portal and decide what to do. Once sent, the case only moves on with their decision or the office's.

close.title: Close the case?
close.body: Once closed it no longer changes.

decide.title: Record the decision on behalf of the contractor
decide.body: The decision is recorded as the carrier's, in place of the contractor, and cannot be changed later.

warehouseReturn.title: Return the damage to the warehouse
warehouseReturn.body: The case ends and the goods go back to stock. This cannot be undone.
warehouseReturn.noteLabel: Why does it go back to the warehouse?

cancel.title: Cancel the case
cancel.body: Use it when the damage was opened by mistake. This cannot be undone.

settlement.title: Goods settlement
settlement.hint: Enter, per item, how much was paid and by whom. The damage has no trip: the settlement is recorded without a charge.
settlement.loadFailed: Could not read the saved settlement. What you save here replaces it.

issues.productCodeDuplicated: This item is already in the settlement.
